source: Curated seed list. A daily job appends new items to `ideas` (keep `id` unique) and bumps `updated`.

ideas.name: Istanbul
ideas.note: Blue Mosque, Süleymaniye and the Bosphorus; mild autumn weather.

ideas.name: Granada
ideas.note: Alhambra palace and the Albaicín quarter; spring gardens.

ideas.name: Córdoba
ideas.note: The Mezquita and the May patios festival.

ideas.name: Sarajevo
ideas.note: Baščaršija bazaar and Gazi Husrev-beg Mosque; halal food everywhere.

ideas.name: Mostar
ideas.note: Stari Most bridge over the Neretva.

ideas.name: Zermatt
ideas.note: Car-free ski village under the Matterhorn.

ideas.name: Innsbruck
ideas.note: Alpine city with ski areas a short tram/bus away.

ideas.name: London
ideas.note: Museums, parks and East London Mosque.

ideas.name: Reykjavík
ideas.note: Northern lights; very short winter days (check prayer times!).

ideas.name: Banff
ideas.note: Rockies skiing; Lake Louise in summer.

ideas.name: Niagara Falls
ideas.note: Easy family day trip from Toronto.

ideas.name: Marrakech
ideas.note: Koutoubia Mosque and souks; avoid peak summer heat.

ideas.name: Kuala Lumpur
ideas.note: Masjid Negara, Petronas Towers, great halal food.

ideas.name: Mont-Tremblant
ideas.note: Fall colours in October, skiing in winter.
